shots.purpose: Hook. Torchlit diary pages turning: the same line over and over
Walking down the road to the lamp; the torch on the post blazes at us
Close: Mick's torch lashed to the post with twine. No one there
Reverse: the beam reaches back up the road and lights one upstairs window
A key on a luggage tag hangs under the torch: 'Back door'. His hand takes it
Mick's back door hung with wolfsbane; key in, the lock turns, the door gives
Torch along a shelf of twenty notebooks, 2006 to 2025
Memory: Mick at the lamp, torch lashed above him, writing one-handed
The log: 'S. at window. Held.' month after month
2006: neat 'Both boys in by dark', then the shaky page: 'D. took my arm.'; jolt on 'Danny's.'
Danny's texts from Part I in his hand
The 2026 notebook, last page: 'If I go, keep D. away from the boy.'; push, jolt on 'out.'
New message: 'Saw a light at Mick's' / 'Coming round'
Whip-turn: the back door handle rattles, the lock gives, it opens a crack
Black. Whisper 'He has a key.' Title THE WATCH, PART II
